answer: An identity earns its seat through Licensed radio operator shift record with radio operators confirmation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 629 aliases would need 629 separate proofs, each costing about 95 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. What carries the dune here is verification, the trellis of cost is what stops the farm, and the violet of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
